=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/sync_contract_list_union.py:255-260 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The append-only base check in `_validate` (`base_list = base_data.get(key)` followed by `if not isinstance(base_list, list): raise Ineligible("list_not_union")`) treats a bare or missing merge-base entrypoint key as a non-list, because `read_entrypoints:` with no items loads as `None`. It therefore rejects a valid two-sided first-entry append, and the reason token `list_not_union` misstates the cause.
  WHY: The helper exits 3, and the poller logs `outcome=ineligible reason=list_not_union` and falls back to the LLM conflict resolver, which spends a resolver dispatch and an `INTEGRATION_CONFLICT_LIFETIME_MAX` budget slot. It fails closed, so nothing is merged wrongly. Reviewers disagree on severity: minimax_minimax-m3 rates it MAJOR (a regression from the last autofix run) and the others rate it NIT. The highest was used. Suggested fix: coerce None to `[]` before the isinstance check.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:12462-12674 | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The PR-head pre-push test gate reports a `shellcheck` failure, which is likely caused by the new 200+ line function `sync_contract_list_union_merge` added in this PR.
  WHY: A failing `shellcheck` job will block the merge. The notes from anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash say they could not tie this to any error-level line.
- scripts/sync_contract_list_union.py:227-268 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The append-only check in `_validate` depends on the optional `base_text` argument. The call sites in `merge_contract` (line 285) are not audited to guarantee `base_text` is never `None` when `affected` keys are present.
  WHY: If `affected` keys are present but `base_text` is `None`, the `Ineligible("list_not_union")` check at lines 262-263 is skipped, which may produce an incorrect deterministic merge instead of falling back to the LLM resolver.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/sync_contract_list_union.py:_validate, lines 258-260 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The append-only check (`base_list = base_data.get(key)` followed by `if not isinstance(base_list, list): raise Ineligible("list_not_union")`) rejects a merge-base list written as a bare key with no items, which loads as None. This happens even when both sides append their first entry, the earlier union check at lines 239-250 passes, and `_resolve` accepts the hunk.
  WHY: The helper exits 3 with the wrong reason token. The poller logs "SYNC_LIST_UNION_V1 outcome=ineligible reason=list_not_union" and falls back to the LLM resolver, spending a run and a dispatch-budget slot. It fails closed. Fix: add `if base_list is None: base_list = []` before the isinstance check.
